carrier.sentence: During spring workdays volunteer Rowan checks seedlings along the shaded north fence.
Beside the tool shed volunteer Mira maintains a small bed of medicinal herbs.
Before weekend classes instructor Tavi arranges clean gloves near the washing station.
Several rain barrels are connected to gutters along the community greenhouse.
The eastern plot was initially planted with peas and cool-weather greens.
For the orchard edge volunteers ordered bare-root shrubs from a local nursery.
A neighborhood seed exchange draws dozens of gardeners near the first frost.
An illustrated planting log lets Rowan compare harvest dates across recent seasons.
Families grow tomatoes and climbing beans on sturdy cedar frames.
An autumn workshop led by Tavi focused on saving seeds from beans.
Gardeners watered the transplants afterward to settle soil around each root.
Next season coordinators may relocate the picnic table beneath a larger tree.
Each monthly newsletter includes Mira reporting which vegetables reached the pantry.
A narrow pollinator strip continues beyond the main beds toward the sidewalk.
New compost signs prepared by Rowan use simple drawings for younger visitors.
At midday the solar pump's output keeps a shallow birdbath circulating.
Visitors usually gather beside the mural painted across the storage shed.
Between two herb beds a central path allows wheelbarrows to pass easily.
On every wooden plot sign the gardener's name remains visible through summer.
